_comment: Cards that exist only for the total-shield test (tests/unit/test_prevent_all_damage.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_retriever` is Rescue Retriever's third line -- prevent all damage to OTHER attacking Soldiers you control -- and `exclude_self` plus `attacking` are the two clauses that make it not a blanket shield. `t_soldier` is a plain Soldier for it to protect, and `t_absorber_two` is an absorb 2 creature used to pin that the two rules are different rather than two sizes of one.

cards.name: Test Retriever
cards.oracle_text: Prevent all damage that would be dealt to other attacking Soldiers you control.
